pages.text: String, a Netherite Ingot and two Breeze Crystals. Worn on the head.

pages.title: Seeing the scan
pages.text:
With the goggles on, a scan draws every block it reported as a coloured box **through the rock**, for about twelve seconds.  
They show nothing on their own. Nothing is revealed that the detector did not already tell you: the boxes are exactly the blocks it just reported.

pages.title: Strain
pages.text: Each visualisation adds **20 strain**, which bleeds off on its own. Cross **100** and the goggles give you **Nausea** and refuse to draw until they recover.

pages.title: Wear
pages.text:
Hover them to see the number. The detector itself is never blocked, so the counts keep coming even when the picture will not.  
Goggles wear by 1 per ore block reported while worn, and take Breeze Shards like the detector.

pages.title: Haste
pages.text: A scan that finds something also grants **Haste** while the goggles are on, for twelve seconds.

pages.title: Which is stronger
pages.text:
**Haste II** on a single loaded liquid, **Haste I** on two or more. A focused tank sweeps the smallest volume of the three, so it gets the stronger hand.  
Strain refuses it exactly as it refuses the highlight.
